heading: SCSS Investment Rules: Avoid These 5 Mistakes Before Investing ₹30 Lakh
tldr: The Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme (SCSS) currently offers an attractive interest rate of 8.2% for the October-December 2026 quarter.
Retirees can now invest a maximum of ₹30 lakh in SCSS, providing a stable income stream.
Common mistakes include not fully understanding eligibility criteria and overlooking the tax implications of the interest earned.
Premature withdrawals come with penalties, making it crucial to assess liquidity needs before investing.
Proper nomination and understanding account extension rules are vital for smooth operation and succession.
caption:
Thinking about investing in the Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme (SCSS)? It offers a good interest rate, but there are a few important things to know before putting in your money, especially with the new ₹30 lakh limit. Avoid common mistakes like not understanding tax rules or early withdrawal penalties. Learn how to make the most of your SCSS investment by reading our full article.
